Little radish sandwiches

Peppery radish sandwiches are the first
thing to vanish from any garden party ted.

SERVES 6

1 bunch radishes
12 slices brown bread,
crusts removed

butter, at room temperature,
for spreading
flaky salt, to taste

Choose the softest loaf
you can find so the
sandwiches stay tender and
the radishes keep
their crunch.

1 Trim the radishes and shave them finely. Sprinkle with salt,
leave in a sieve for 15 minutes, then blot dry.

2 Butter every slice of bread right to the edges. Lay the
radishes over six slices and season lightly.
Close with the other slices. Press gently with your palm.

3 Cut the sandwiches into quarters or small rectangles
Pile onto a chilled plate.
